sn45.157:1.1: sāvatthīnidānaṃ. seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppannaṃ mahāmeghaṃ tamenaṃ mahāvāto antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
sn45.157:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
sn45.157:1.3: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ magagaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
sn45.157:1.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti …pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.157:1.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasametīti.
